8810820108585.description:
Epitome of Luxury: Asim Jofa's Motia Fragrance Scented Candle

Elevate your senses and your living space with the exquisite new addition to Asim Jofa's luxury collection - the Motia Fragrance Scented Candle. The Motia fragrance is an ode to Arabian Jasmine, a bloom cherished for its elegant and intoxicating aroma. The candle also has a bit of Oud, which is a warm, musky, animalic, and slightly sweet fragrance. Each breath draws you deeper into the world of luxury, where floral notes intermingle with subtle undertones to create an atmosphere of tranquility and sophistication. Whether you're seeking relaxation or setting the stage for a special occasion, the Motia Scented Candle is your perfect companion.
Encased in a sleek black marine marble jar with a matching marble lid. The rich, dark marble provides a striking contrast to the luminous flame within, making it an eye-catching centerpiece in any room. Indulge in the essence of Arabian Jasmine with the Asim Jofa Motia Fragrance Scented Candle. With its stunning design and captivating aroma, it promises to transform any space into a realm of luxury and elegance. Ignite this exquisite candle and let its fragrance envelop your world in a sensual, unforgettable embrace.
Asim Jofa's Motia Scented Candle - Where luxury meets fragrance, and elegance meets design.

DETAILS:
1. Burn candle on a stable, level, heat & fire-resistant surface.
2.Use a candle snuffer to avoid dangers associated with blowing out hot wax.
3. Wax has a memory. Burn your candle for at least one hour the first time to create an even melt pool and avoid tunneling.
4. Do not burn the candle for more than max 4 hours at a time to avoid overheating and large flames.
5. Trim wick to 1/4"before lighting
6. Never leave burning candle unattended & keep out of reach of children and pets
7. Keep away from drafts and vibrations.
8. Keep your candles free of debris, dust and other foreign elements to enjoy a clean burn every time.
9. Burn time upto 60 hours (500 G)
10. Made with Soy wax blend
11. Hand poured in Pakistan

Weight = 2.48 KG
